deterministic_candidate_selection.rule: one lower-median existing candidate per parent_seed/interface/joint/original_feasible group after tick, numeric uid, decision_id, source sort

plan_upper_bound.per_parent_rule: one plan per release ring row (o2m,m2i), six plans per release final row (i2f)

scope.coverage_limit: The nine label JSONL rows contain teacher_gate/teacher_proposal but no candidate feasibility/reason arrays; candidate feasibility/reason counts below therefore cover only existing witness candidate records and do not infer unqueried rows.
